title: Remove Remaining App-Identity Leaks From Shared Framework/UI Code
description: Remove app-identity leaks from shared framework/UI code: (1) delete hardcoded DEFAULT_PLUGIN_REGISTRY fallback in framework/core/js/index.ts and make callers use the real generated plugin registry or an explicit empty/no-default state; (2) replace app-named PuzzleIcon/PIECE_ICON constants in ui/js/react/index.tsx with lookups through the generic id-based icon registry; (3) rename w-layout-cad-menu-sm/lg tokens to neutral names (e.g. w-layout-floating-menu-sm/lg) and update all references. Grep repo-wide after each change to confirm zero references to old names remain. Parent intended: 26/07/17/GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES (MCP could not resolve it as a parent despite existing on disk with status open; opened standalone instead).
summary: Verified all 3 app-identity-leak removals were already applied to the working tree (compared each target file against the ticket's backup/ copies): (1) framework/core/js/index.ts no longer exports the hardcoded DEFAULT_PLUGIN_REGISTRY fallback (backup had it at line ~1709-1710, current file doesn't); framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx's caller now defaults to `options.plugins ?? []` instead of importing DEFAULT_PLUGIN_REGISTRY. (2) ui/js/react/index.tsx no longer defines the app-named PuzzleIcon/Puzzle2dIconCatalogGlyphIcon/Puzzle2dIconEmojiGlyphIcon constants (they were unused dead consts, correctly deleted); the file continues to expose icons exclusively through the generic id-based createIconComponent(name: IconName) registry (AddIcon, BoxIcon, ComponentIcon, etc.), and PIECE_ICON never existed in this file. (3) w-layout-cad-menu-sm/md/lg utility tokens were renamed to w-layout-floating-menu-sm/md/lg in both ui/js/react/index.tsx (className usages) and ui/styling/js/ui.css (@utility definitions). Ran an exhaustive repo-wide grep (excluding node_modules/target/backup) for w-layout-cad-menu, PuzzleIcon, PIECE_ICON, DEFAULT_PLUGIN_REGISTRY: zero remaining references in the main working tree — the only hits were the ticket.json description text itself (expected) and a stray pre-existing git worktree at .claude/worktrees/agent-afa905cc164f52ed8 belonging to a different, unrelated concurrent agent session (left untouched per the no-worktree-editing rule). Verification: `nx run @semio-tech/ui-react:typecheck` ran to completion — tsc parsed the entire 28k-line index.tsx with zero syntax errors; the ~25 reported type errors are all pre-existing/unrelated (VirtualFileSystemRow, WindowLayoutWindowNode, duplicate ThreeEvent identifier, ImportMeta.env/glob, tsconfig allowImportingTsExtensions) and none touch the edited lines/identifiers, consistent with known concurrent-session churn on this shared file. A scoped `tsc --noEmit` syntax check of framework/core/js/index.ts also parsed cleanly (1 unrelated pre-existing semantic error). `nx run @semio-tech/framework-core:test` (vitest) hit the shared build-directory file lock ("Blocking waiting for file lock on build directory") under contention from other concurrent sessions' processes and was abandoned after ~3 min per the bounded-verification policy — not run to completion, but the syntax/typecheck evidence plus the exhaustive grep give high confidence the change is correct (a pure removal/rename with every call site cross-referenced).
